examples.title: A small native Quidra program
examples.summary: Explicit types, indentation-based blocks, no semicolons, and a top-level call in one small program compiled through LLVM.

examples.title: Tensors with shape contracts
examples.summary: Exact-rank tensor<real32>{3, _, _} bindings, strict singleton broadcasting, .item() and .shape(), plus math.matmul and math.mean from the first-party Math package on 2-D tensors.

examples.title: Bindings, values and loops
examples.summary: Explicit and inferred := bindings, string interpolation, an int[] copy that stays independent after mutation, a collection for loop and an explicit range header and an if/elif/else chain.

examples.title: Defaults, names and generics
examples.summary: A parameter type inferred from its := default, a call with named arguments written with = and a constrained generic T largest<T: ordered>(T[] values) whose type argument is inferred from typed int[] and real64[] variables.

examples.title: Errors and match
examples.summary: int | error is the whole failure story: try propagates the parse error, error(...) creates one and an exhaustive match handles success and failure without exceptions.

examples.title: Classes with value semantics
examples.summary: A class with initialization arguments and ordered field assignments, a public and a private method, an independent copy initialized with :=, an explicit &alias that writes through and value equality with ==.

examples.title: Write authority at the call
examples.summary: A const int[] value parameter receives a snapshot; an int[] & parameter takes writable storage through the marked .double_all(&data) call.

examples.title: Declarative command line
examples.summary: One cli block declares a required positional argument(), an int option(default = 1) and a bool flag(); field names are the command-line names.

examples.title: Values by default, storage by request
examples.summary: An int[] copied into a new binding with := stays independent when the copy is mutated; an explicit &writer alias writes through to x while a const snapshot keeps the earlier independent value.

examples.title: Authority is part of the call
examples.summary: A const int value parameter can only observe its value; an int & parameter may write and the checker lets it initialize storage that was declared without a value.

examples.title: Static operator types and explicit conversions
examples.summary: Literals default to int or take int32 context; nat64 + int32 uses int32. Numeric value arguments convert to the parameter type with explicit-cast checks. Assignments remain explicit, and operand variables keep their types.

examples.title: Absence, failure and value
examples.summary: lookup returns int | none | error; an explicitly typed union binding keeps the error alternative and an exhaustive match handles each one.

examples.title: Monotonic name resolution
examples.summary: The same spelling x is reused in disjoint scopes, which is allowed; shadowing a visible name would be rejected.
